chapter: Early bands and the road to New York
title: The Jones home in Pontiac as a rehearsal place after Hank left
summary: The house became a gathering place for Elvin and Thad about ten years after Hank had left.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, what I want to ask you, maybe I should for your train of thought – – I couldn't find it. Somewhere, I read it, your home in Pontiac became a place where musicians rehearsed and practiced.
That happened, but it happened after I left Pontiac.
That was part of Elvin’s experience.

That’s right. It was with Elvin and Thad. I had left Pontiac may be 10 years prior to them. I was already in. I had already done a tour of one-nighters in the South. I had been to New York working on 52nd.
